text: Welcome to Cendara University! This guide provides a detailed overview of our main campus, highlighting building locations, parking areas, emergency stations, and essential facilities. For your convenience, refer to the descriptions below to navigate and familiarize yourself with campus resources.

- Name: Ivory Academic Hall | Abbreviation: IVH | Location: Central Quad | Departments/Offices: Mathematics, Philosophy, Academic Advising

- Name: Sylvan Library & Archives | Abbreviation: SLA | Location: Library Lane | Departments/Offices: Library Services, Special Collections, Study Spaces

  - Location: SLA, 4th Floor

  - Location: Central Quad

  - Locations: Main Entrance (South Gate), North Crescent, Commerce Circle

text: All major buildings are wheelchair accessible with automatic doors and elevators. Accessible parking spaces are available in each parking lot and garage.
path: Cendara University Campus Map Guide > 7. Accessibility

text:
- 24/7 Campus Security Office: Located in the Walker Administration Building, Suite 105.
- Escort Service: Available 6pm–2am daily. Call (732) 555-4488.
- Automated External Defibrillators (AEDs): Located in all major buildings, clearly marked.
